items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Monk was a good example of the use of common phrases to express himself... He used the word “mother,” which is half a word, all the time.

ctx.x: I imagine also with the rhythmic expression, that you may have to find a particular word that matches a musical statement in a sense. I would again help to have a wide command of the vocabulary to make that happen.

Yes. And you also find out the true beauty of slang. Slang is beautiful. It really is beautiful. Somebody once said that slang is language rolling up its sleeves and going to work, because it is the best way that ordinary, not-well-educated people have of expressing themselves, and it has a beauty about it. It’s really beautiful. Monk was a good example of the use of common phrases to express himself. He used profane phrases, too, but on his lips, they were not profane. Like he used the word “mother,” which is…
You write in the vernacular a lot.
